title: The sync range leak gate exempts any value the private query-log store already holds, so a store GUID copied into a public file passes sync and then blocks publish
goal: kbpublic.range_leaks counts a value as already public only when a file that publish's projection keeps holds it, so a value only kb/_querylog or a _logs.csv holds is refused by the sync leak gate; the sync gate reads no public-values cache that publish's scan filled, and SCAN_FORM stays 6

run:
import os, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
def sh(*a, cwd=None, env=None):
    return subprocess.run(a, cwd=cwd, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True)
env = dict(os.environ, GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="t", GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="t", GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="t", GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="t")
guid = "-".join(["3f2b8c1e", "9d4a", "4e7b", "8a61", "5c0d2e9f7b13"])
def clone():
    t = tempfile.mkdtemp(); c = t + "/c"; os.mkdir(c)
    subprocess.run(["tar", "-x", "-C", c], input=subprocess.run(["git", "archive", "HEAD"], capture_output=True, check=True).stdout, check=True)
    return t, c
def commit(c, m):
    sh("git", "add", "-A", cwd=c, env=env); sh("git", "commit", "-q", "-m", m, "--no-verify", cwd=c, env=env)
t, c = clone()
os.makedirs(c + "/kb/_querylog", exist_ok=True); open(c + "/kb/_querylog/x.jsonl", "w").write('{"id":"%s"}\n' % guid)
sh("git", "init", "-q", "-b", "main", cwd=c, env=env); commit(c, "base")
up = sh("git", "rev-parse", "HEAD", cwd=c, env=env).stdout.strip()
os.makedirs(c + "/probe"); open(c + "/probe/note.txt", "w").write("session %s\n" % guid); commit(c, "probe")
r = sh(sys.executable, "-I", "-c", "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import kbpublic as k; print(k.range_leaks(sys.argv[1], '.'))", up, cwd=c, env=env)
shutil.rmtree(t, ignore_errors=True)
assert r.stdout.strip() not in ("", "[]"), ("a value the private store holds passes the sync range gate", r.stdout[-200:], r.stderr[-200:])

notes: Review gap 1 of SP-kkov6bbz: kbpublic.py:849 range_leaks -> history_refusals(projected=False) -> leak_verdicts (:701) -> public_values(up) (:649) scans every file of origin/main, the store included; at review HEAD 9,420 private files held 237,655 GUID-shaped hits. Publish still refuses (no public leak), so the stall BG-okrkeohe fixed returns.
